AUTHORITY: PRIMARY OFFICIAL
SOURCE: amended_irr_bp_344_official_gazette_2.pdf | page 17 | Appendix A, 1.2(b), Table A.1.1, and 1.2(d)
CANONICAL FACTS:
- Gradient not steeper than 1:20. Steeper gradients may be allowed in special cases depending on the length to be covered.
- Table A.1.1 fields reconstructed from the official text are:
  Maximum Slope | Maximum Length | Maximum Rise | Interval for Landing
  1:20 | - | - | 15m
  1:15 | 10.50m | 700mm | 10m
- Accessible ramps with a total length longer than 10.50m shall be provided with intermediate landings with a minimum length of 1800 mm.
- This official source page does not list a 1:12 row in Table A.1.1.
USE RULES:
- Treat this card as binding unless another PRIMARY OFFICIAL source in the provided context clearly supersedes it.
- Do not replace the 1:15 values above with alternative values unless another PRIMARY OFFICIAL 2024 source in the provided context explicitly states them.
- If no other PRIMARY OFFICIAL source supplies a 1:12 accessible-ramp value, say the provided context does not contain it.
